title: MultiNRC: A Challenging and Native Multilingual Reasoning Evaluation Benchmark for LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces MultiNRC, a benchmark for evaluating multilingual reasoning in LLMs. While one of its four categories is 'cultural/tradition reasoning', which includes references to religious holidays like Día de la Candelaria or the French calendar of saints, these are treated as cultural/temporal logic puzzles rather than an evaluation of religious faith, theology, or moral/ethical frameworks.
